column3: (Anti-clickjacking header: every page sends X-Frame-Options DENY and frame-ancestors 'none')
(Content Security Policy must be present on pages)
(The sort parameter is reflected into a select value; React escapes it, kept as a warning to review)
(Basic auth guards only the TEST MODE inbox, served over HTTPS on the server)
(Timestamps in API data are order and event times, not secrets)
(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy is not needed; the app embeds no cross-origin content)
(Non-storable content is intended: private pages send Cache-Control no-store)
